mac.welcome.title: Welcome to Piomio
mac.welcome.body:
Piomio is your personal agent. It runs in the background on this Mac and you talk to it in your browser.

After the install it starts by itself and opens in your browser, where you choose a password. Your chats, agents and the vault stay on this Mac.
mac.conclusion.title: Piomio is installed
mac.conclusion.body:
Piomio is opening now: choose how this computer is used. Later, open it from Applications or the menu bar.

To remove it, move Piomio from Applications to the Trash. Your data stays in ~/Library/Application Support/Piomio.
app.reset.title: Delete all Piomio data?
app.reset.body: Piomio stops, then its chats, agents, memory, the vault with your secrets, plugins, settings and this computer's connection to a hub are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
app.reset.keeps: Your Claude Code and Codex sign-ins stay: they belong to those tools, not to Piomio.
app.testBuild: Test build: its own data and ports, next to the app.
app.welcome.title: How will you use this computer?
app.welcome.hub.title: A new Piomio on this computer
app.welcome.hub.body: Your agent runs here. Chats, agents and the vault stay on this computer.
app.welcome.node.title: Connect to my Piomio
app.welcome.node.body: Your Piomio already runs elsewhere. This computer becomes one of its machines: agents can use its Claude Code, Codex and the folders you allow.
app.pair.title: Connect this computer
app.pair.linkHint: Ask Piomio in the chat to connect a computer and paste its link here. Opening the link on this computer fills this in by itself.
app.pair.name: Machine name
app.link.title: Connect to {hub}?
app.link.body: This computer becomes a machine of {hub}.
app.link.hubMode: This computer runs its own Piomio now. It stops, and its data stays here: Set up again… in the menu brings it back.
app.error.title: Piomio did not start
app.error.notStarted: Piomio did not answer in time. Show the log to see why, or try again.
app.error.failed: Piomio keeps stopping. Show the log to see why, or try again.
app.error.portBusy: Port {port} is taken by another program, so Piomio cannot start. Close that program and try again.
app.error.noRuntime: Piomio's files are damaged. Install Piomio again.
pio.name: Pio
pio.control.title: Let Pio use the mouse and keyboard?
pio.control.body: Pio will move the mouse, click and type on this computer. To take control back, press Esc or the switch in Pio's card. It ends by itself after 10 minutes.
pio.frame.label: Pio is driving — press Esc to take back
